title: Fast-BEV++: Fast by Algorithm, Deployable by Design
description:
arXiv:2512.08237v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: The advancement of vision-only BEV (Bird's-Eye-View) perception is hindered by the fundamental trade-off between perception accuracy and deployment efficiency. We introduce Fast-BEV++, resolving this tension through two principles: Fast by Algorithm and Deployable by Design. By decomposing view transformation into a hardware-oriented Index-Gather-Reshape pipeline, Fast-BEV++ eliminates custom kernels while achieving no less than 3 times speedup over baseline methods. Empirically, Fast-BEV++ establishes a new state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-off on nuScenes, achieving 0.488 NDS while sustaining real-time inference at over 134 FPS. In particular, depth supervision yields consistent and tangible performance gains, maintaining the highest accuracy among comparable methods. The decomposed architecture enables seamless real-time deployment on production-level platforms, eliminating hardware constraints without loss of efficiency. Code and models are released on the linked project page.
